r1_errors_found.target: M-01a.change + open_questions[0] (O-1) + plan.md:136 — auth probe command form
r1_errors_found.error: The falsifiable auth probe is `claude -p 'ok'` (M-01a.change line 97, correction-1 line 8, open_questions[0] line 732, plan.md:136 reproduction command). But EVERY real detached spawn uses `claude -p --bare` (verified: pre-compact-witness.sh:68 `timeout 120 claude -p --bare ...`; auto-dream-check.sh:117 `claude -p --bare ...`). --bare is the actual failure trigger — bash.log:9028 records the operator isolating `claude -p --bare 'ok'` vs `claude -p 'ok'` precisely because bare is what breaks. A probe using `claude -p 'ok'` (no --bare) can return exit 0 while the --bare spawns fail 'Not logged in', so M-01a would report the metabolism HEALTHY while dream/witness/instinct stay dead — the exact false-green failure mode M-00/M-01a exist to prevent, and the O-1 operator reproduction would run the wrong command and wrongly conclude auth is fine.
r1_errors_found.fix: Change every probe/reproduction command in M-01a.change, correction #1, open_questions[0], and plan.md:136 from `claude -p 'ok'` to `claude -p --bare 'ok'`. M-01a green_assertion must assert the fake claude shim is invoked WITH --bare and that a foreground non-bare success cannot mask a detached --bare failure; the probe must mirror the exact spawn form (nohup detached + --bare).
